Bring back a deleted rule by its ID; rule list --deleted shows it

## Usage

```text
chainmail rule restore <id>
```

## Examples

```sh
# find the ID of a deleted rule, then restore it by that ID
chainmail rule list --deleted
chainmail rule restore ru_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
